messages:
alicia: quick sync — we need to settle pin deprecation semantics. last night the edge started returning 503s when anchors expired and several clients retried hot and overloaded the resolver.

jordan: saw that, +1. traffic spike correlated with pin evicts. users on dedicated infra hit it harder.

minh: high-level proposal: distinguish hard-evict (remove binding) from soft-deprecate (still resolve but mark). soft_deprecate pins let router return a fallback variant while signaling clients to re-resolve gradually.

ryan: curious how clients should behave. full immediate re-resolve will thrash the control plane. want a client-side probe pattern?

alicia: exactly. plan: encode a probe policy in pin metadata. clients sample a small percentage of requests to force a fresh resolve, otherwise use cached binding. backoff on failures.

jordan: can we also surface TTL/tombstone timestamps so observability can alert on cascading probes?

minh: yep. rough metadata sketch:

```
pin_metadata:
  id: "model-prod-v3"
  pin_mode: "soft_deprecate" # values: active | soft_deprecate | hard_evict
  probe:
    sample_rate: 0.05
    timeout_ms: 300
    max_consecutive_failures: 3
    on_failure: "exponential_backoff"
  tombstone_after: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"
```

ryan: LGTM. small nit: sample_rate should be 0 for private clusters unless tenant opts in. otherwise tenant traffic could leak into resolver SLOs.

alicia: good catch. we can default sample_rate to 0 for Dedicated/Private and let console set it.

jordan: what does the router do when it sees soft_deprecate? immediate fallback ordering? add header?

minh: router behavior proposal: if pin_mode==soft_deprecate -> try primary binding; if request latency > X or failure -> route to fallback model variant (same family). always attach header `X-Pin-Status: soft_deprecated` and `X-Pin-Tombstone`. that lets clients choose probe/backoff strategy.

alicia: and for observability, emit metric `pin.probe.sample_rate` and a counter for probe failures. create alert if probe failures > 1% of probes for 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `pin-service` rollout v1.9.0 -> canary on infra-prod-a. :rocket:

jordan: one more thought: console should show pin lifecycle timeline and suggested probe rate based on traffic patterns. will file UX ticket.

alicia: action items: I will draft a short RFC with the metadata schema and router semantics (including header names and metrics). @jordan please add console mockups. @minh can you author a router unit test harness for soft_deprecate flows? @ryan can you sanity-check tenant defaults for Dedicated/Private?

minh: on it. I'll include a small harness that simulates 0/5/50% sample_rates and asserts resolver QPS stays under threshold.

ryan: will validate defaults and write a short compat doc for client SDKs (how to honor X-Pin-Status).

alicia: thanks all — aiming to ship RFC by EOD Friday. we'll iterate after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
